title: 生涯スポーツ演習(登山)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesLifelong Sports
educationalGoal:
Through learning activities for mountain climbing, students will:
1)Understand the pleasure derived from sports.
2)Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle.
3)Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice:
This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through mountain climbing:
1. Lecture format
The format will be practice-intensive, held over 1 nights and 2 days at Hakusan after the end of the previous semester.
2. Summary of class
1) Basic mountain climbing knowledge
2) Basic mountain climbing skills
3) Safety management in the mountainous region
3. Equipment
The following equipment is required for safe climbing (plan Hakusan): rucksack, hat, gloves, climbing trousers, trekking shoes (or climbing shoes), socks, rain gear (poncho) sweater, underwear, other winter clothes, toiletries, water bottle, flashlight, sunglasses, medicine, camera, shoelaces, writing utensils, and health certificate.
In particular, a rucksack appropriate for the amount of supplies, rain gear, and trekking shoes are essential. Also, if you bring a stove or tableware for each small group, the activity will be more comfortable.
requiredKnowledge: Prepare mountain climbing equipment on your own. Make preliminary preparations (physical strength adjustments) such as preliminary mountain climbing. Hakusan is a high mountain with long approaches, and thus requires sufficient preparation. Make sure you fully understand safety precautions in mountaineering. Details of the cost, mountain trails, accommodations, etc., will be given at the briefing session. Training expenses (￥26,500 the previous year for travel, accommodations, lunch, miscellaneous expenses, insurance, etc.) are the responsibility of the student.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for mountain climbing and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental mountain climbing skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
(5)Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.
(6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental mountain climbing skills and utilize them roughly in class activities.(3) Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.
